name: shinchantw_cbt_week4_lifecycle_weighted_20260803_133206_201572
sql:
/*
Lifecycle metrics weighted across every cohort that has completed that age.
For an end date D4: age 1 uses D0-D3 cohorts; age 4 uses only D0.
This prevents incomplete lifecycle windows from entering retention or LTV.
*/
WITH Cfg AS (SELECT DATE '2026-07-29' ts, DATE '2026-08-02' te, DATE '2026-05-08' ss),
TB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SC AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
SA AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
M AS (SELECT '新加坡全体' grp,c.u FROM SC c UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android',c.u FROM SC c JOIN SA a ON c.u=a.u),
Cohort AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,DATE_DIFF('day',c.ts,CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE)) cohort_day,e."#account_id" aid FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c LEFT JOIN TB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ts AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.te AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111') GROUP BY 1,2,3
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,DATE_DIFF('day',c.ss,CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE)),e."#account_id" FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ss AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.ts,c.te),c.ss) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
E AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid,DATE_DIFF('day',c.ts,CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE)) event_day,e."$part_event" ev,CASE WHEN e."$part_event"='charge' AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE) AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE) THEN TRY_CAST(e.pay_amount AS DOUBLE)/COALESCE(x.exchange,1) ELSE 0 END revenue
 FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c LEFT JOIN TB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange x ON e."$part_date"=x.ex_date AND e.pay_currency=x.currency WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ts AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.te AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111')
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",DATE_DIFF('day',c.ss,CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE)),e."$part_event",CASE WHEN e."$part_event"='charge' AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE) AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE) THEN TRY_CAST(e.pay_amount_usd AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END
 FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ss AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.ts,c.te),c.ss) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL
),
Ages AS (SELECT day_n FROM UNNEST(SEQUENCE(0,4)) AS t(day_n)),
PerCohort AS (
 SELECT c.grp,c.cohort_day,a.day_n,COUNT(DISTINCT c.aid) cohort_users,
   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.ev='login' AND e.event_day=c.cohort_day+a.day_n THEN c.aid END) retained_users,
   SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_day BETWEEN c.cohort_day AND c.cohort_day+a.day_n THEN e.revenue ELSE 0 END) cumulative_revenue
 FROM Cohort c CROSS JOIN Ages a LEFT JOIN E e ON c.grp=e.grp AND c.aid=e.aid
 WHERE c.cohort_day+a.day_n<=4 GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT grp AS "group_name",day_n AS "lifecycle_day",COUNT(*) AS "included_cohorts",SUM(cohort_users) AS "cohort_users",SUM(retained_users) AS "retained_users",ROUND(100.0*SUM(retained_users)/NULLIF(SUM(cohort_users),0),2) AS "retention_pct",ROUND(SUM(cumulative_revenue)/NULLIF(SUM(cohort_users),0),4) AS "ltv_usd"
FROM PerCohort GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2;
